request:
Turn 1: How many days do I have to return an item bought from Juniper Home Goods?
Turn 2: I purchased it 20 days ago, but it arrived 10 days ago. Am I within the window?

results.title: Juniper Home Goods store policy
results.snippet:
# Juniper Home Goods store policy

Juniper Home Goods accepts returns within 14 days of delivery, instead of the Cartwheel platform default of 30 days. This store window takes precedence for all Juniper Home Goods orders.

results.title: Cartwheel order cancellation policy
results.snippet:
# Cartwheel order cancellation policy

An order can be cancelled at no cost any time before the store ships it. Once an order has shipped it can no longer be cancelled; the buyer should instead wait for delivery and request a return under the Cartwheel return policy.

results.title: Cartwheel return policy
results.snippet:
# Cartwheel return policy

Items bought on Cartwheel can be returned within 30 days of delivery. The window counts from the delivery date, not the purchase date. Items must be in the condition described by the store's listing. Individual stores may override this window; see the store overrides polic

response:
Turn 1: Juniper Home Goods accepts returns within **14 days of delivery**, which is different from the standard 30 days for the Cartwheel platform. This means you need to return any item purchased from them within that timeframe. 

If you need more details, just let me know!

Turn 2: Since Juniper Home Goods has a return policy of 14 days from the delivery date and your item arrived 10 days ago, you would have 4 days left to return it. However, since it's been 20 days since you made the purchase, you are currently outside the return window based on the delivery date.

If you need assistance with anything else, feel free to ask!
expected: Use Juniper’s 14-day window measured from delivery. An item delivered 10 days ago is within the time window, regardless of purchase being 20 days ago; other return conditions may still apply.
